name: JSON to Types
description: Generate TypeScript, Go, Rust or Java type definitions from a JSON sample.

hints.input: This is structural inference, not full schema derivation: the generated types only cover fields present in the sample.
hints.output: Numbers are parsed as json.Number, so 1 and 1.0 are not treated as different values.

faq.a: No. Fields absent from the sample do not appear in the output.

faq.q: How are array element types determined?
faq.a: Each item is inferred and merged; conflicting types become a union.
